_comment: Curated SIL / OLAC / eBible resource register for the Sambalic cluster (Aeta pilot),
consumed by scripts/derive-sil-resources.mjs. Keyed by language code, then by
resources bucket (corpora / dictionaries / grammars / tools / lexical). Every entry
MUST cite its basis in a source string or notes field naming the SIL REAP archive
item id, OLAC index, or eBible.org page it was verified from (enumerated 2026-07-19
from the OLAC per-code indexes; local working copies + full inventory:
local-assets/MANIFEST.md, gitignored). This is resource EXISTENCE only (language-card
boundary invariant kind 2): names, URLs, types. No content is copied, no measured
scores may appear here (lint R3/R4), licenses are recorded only where documented —
index, not arbiter. Scripture entries point at eBible.org (content © Wycliffe Inc.,
language-specific facts live in this file, never hardcoded in the deriver.
